title: recording
description: A specific narration/production of a work: narrators, abridged flag, runtime, chapters, publisher(s), and region-scoped identifiers. One production released in several marketplaces stays ONE recording: the region rides on the identifier (asin[], the object form of isbn[]) and on publishers[], never on a second record.

narrators.description: The recording's narrators as person slugs. The slug is the identity, so the list may not repeat one.

abridged.description: Whether this narration is abridged. Optional: absence means unknown, so importers omit it rather than guessing.

publisher.description: The publisher of record for this production. One production can be issued by a different imprint in another marketplace; those go in publishers[], and this field stays the one the record leads with.

publishers.description: OTHER regions' imprints of this same production, one entry per region. It never restates the top-level publisher (that fact already has a home) and never repeats a region. Emitted only when a source STATED a regional publisher - absence means nothing is known about that marketplace, not that the publisher of record covers it.

added_at.description: When this recording entered the database. Stamped at creation by the importer and the intake bot as a plain date; records dated by the one-time git-history backfill carry that commit's full timestamp verbatim. Optional, since records predating the field carry none.
